text: MELITENSIS TERRA, the Earth of Malta: an earth, which bears are two very different kinds; the one of which is a bolo, the other a mart. The latter is that known by medical authors under this name; the former is the like each earth now in us, but both being brought from the fama places, are critically cal-led by the fama name. The Maltelle mari, which is the _loro Melithero_ of medical matters, is a loef, cumming, and light early of an unequal and irregular texture; and, when exposed to the weather, too falls into that field powder, but when preferred and dried, it becomes a loose, light safe, or a dirty white colour, with a grayift calf; it is rough to the touch, adheres firmly to the tongue, is way easily carried to paw- due between the fingers– and flints the hands. Thrown into the water, it (wells, and afterwards moulders a way into a fine powder. It ferhens very violently with acids. Both kinds are found in great abundance in the illand of Malta, and the latter has been much offered as a remedy against the bits of venomous animals.
